split.rule: Use the existing precision split and prespecified UTC Monday-to-Monday buckets. Allocate only closed campaigns contained within each window. Report results by BUY and SELL from the actual mixed-direction book.

cost_rule: Replay at pinned nominal mechanics. On those fills deduct zero, one or two times the original incremental stress charge. Cost sensitivity holds fills, sizes, initial risk and occupancy fixed.
recovery_rule: Reuse the already registered Precision recovery classifier with prior events from the reconstructed FAST control. Keep the prior events and candidate eligibility fixed across alternative books.
occupancy_rule: Chronological one-slot replay at nominal costs. S5 keeps its native archived fills and same-close priority. Preserve valid offers rejected by occupancy or another portfolio reason, including their separate frozen fill potential.

primary_inference.rule: Use the pre-existing later-archive paired five-day stressed net-R statistic with Holm correction across the four fixed contrasts. Interpret descriptively given repeated access to the archive. Full S5-plus-FAST ablations and weekly and directional summaries are descriptive.

decision: Keep S5, original GOLD PRO and forward seal intact. A positive archive cell identifies a hypothesis for independent testing.
